# Apple Icon Composer demo icon

`StarterApp/StarterApp/AppIcon.icon` is Apple's *Icon Composer Demo Project* (`Demo Project.icon`), copied unchanged from the iOS 27 Icon Templates download on [Apple Design Resources](https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/). It is the template's placeholder app icon.

It is Apple's work and is covered by the Apple Design Resources license in this folder, not by this repository's license. That license allows its use for mock-ups of interfaces for software that runs on Apple platforms, and asks that anyone receiving it be made aware of its restrictions. Replace the icon with your own before you ship an app, then delete this folder.
